auditability.prompt: Logs are searchable and available for both the platform and development team. Application logs written to standard output and log files must be sent to a central application for troubleshooting. The Enterprise Architecture NFR needs to be completed by the app team prior to release deployment.
Maintain logs of user and system activity to support system failure, system response, issues, and incident response.

auditability.gate_name: Implement tracking ID for log messages
auditability.prompt: Log messages include a tracking ID where possible to implement. A unique request tracking ID can help in understanding the flow of requests.
Log REST API calls to capture external component interaction for troubleshooting. The Enterprise NFR needs to be completed by the app team.

Log application messages with standard log libraries to make it easier to capture the right information in the right format. The Enterprise NFR needs to be completed by the app team and validated prior to release deployment.
Prevent logging confidential and/or restricted data. Mask or remove confidential information from logs prior to saving. The Enterprise NFR needs to be completed by the app team and validated.
Critical and error log messages created in the client device (mobile or browser) need to be sent to the application central log system.

error_handling.prompt: Log system errors. The Enterprise Architecture NFR needs to be completed by the app team prior to release deployment into production.
All APIs and internal REST controllers must return standardized HTTP status codes and headers to help consumers handle errors.
Include client error tracking. The Enterprise NFR needs to be completed by the app team and validated, prior to release deployment into production.

availability.prompt: Latency control, set timeouts on I/O operations to prevent the application from waiting longer than acceptable. The Enterprise NFR needs to be completed by the app team.
Use retry logic to handle system failures. The Enterprise NFR needs to be completed by the app team and validated, prior to release deployment into production.
Throttling requests when capacity limit is reached to avoid impacting all ongoing requests. The Enterprise Architecture NFR needs to be completed by the app team.

availability.gate_name: Set circuit breakers on outgoing requests
availability.prompt: A circuit breaker is used to detect failures and encapsulates the logic of preventing a failure from constantly reoccurring during maintenance, temporary external system failures, or unexpected difficulties.
System can automatically scale as a whole or scale parts of its services as necessary based on probes/monitors providing current usage telemetry to avoid outages or degraded performance.

testing.prompt: Regression test cases must cover all critical and functional areas of the application/component.

llm_pre_analysis.description: LLM pre-analysis to generate dynamic patterns and assess gate applicability using the actual gates in scope

examples.input: Repository contains Python web application with Flask

llm_post_analysis.description: LLM post-analysis to generate final report and recommendations based on actual gates

pattern_generation.description: Generate regex patterns for specific gates from the actual scope

risk_assessment.description: Assess risk level based on gate failures using actual gate severity levels
risk_assessment.prompt_template:
Assess the risk level for the following gate failures based on the actual gates in scope:

Failed Gates: {failed_gates}
Partial Gates: {partial_gates}
Repository Context: {repo_context}

Gate Severity Levels:
- Critical: Immediate action required
- High: High priority remediation
- Medium: Moderate priority
- Low: Low priority

Consider:
1. Security implications
2. Compliance requirements
3. Business impact
4. Technical debt
5. Maintenance overhead

Provide:
- Overall risk score (1-10)
- Risk breakdown by category (Auditability, Error Handling, Availability, Testing)
- Mitigation recommendations
- Timeline for remediation

remediation_planning.description: Generate detailed remediation plans for actual gates

code_quality_assessment.description: Assess overall code quality and maintainability based on gate compliance
code_quality_assessment.prompt_template:
Assess the code quality for the repository based on gate compliance:

Code Metrics: {metrics}
Pattern Matches: {pattern_matches}
File Structure: {file_structure}
Gate Compliance: {gate_compliance}

Evaluate:
1. Code complexity and maintainability
2. Documentation quality
3. Testing coverage
4. Security practices
5. Performance considerations
6. Best practices adherence
7. Gate compliance status

Provide:
- Quality score (1-10)
- Specific improvement areas
- Quick wins vs long-term improvements
- Industry benchmarks comparison

compliance_check.description: Check compliance with industry standards and regulations based on actual gates
compliance_check.prompt_template:
Check compliance with the following standards and actual gates:

Standards: {standards}
Repository: {repo_info}
Industry: {industry}
Available Gates: {available_gates}

Standards to check:
1. Security standards (OWASP, NIST)
2. Privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)
3. Industry-specific requirements
4. Licensing compliance
5. Documentation requirements
6. Gate compliance requirements

Provide:
- Compliance status for each standard
- Gate compliance status
- Missing requirements
- Implementation recommendations
- Audit trail requirements

performance_analysis.description: Analyze performance characteristics and bottlenecks based on availability gates

Analyze performance characteristics based on availability gates:

Dependencies: {dependencies}
Availability Gates: {availability_gates}

2. Database query optimization
3. Memory usage patterns
